plugin.name: eForm Studio
plugin.description: A three-member team: upload a paper form as image, PDF, Excel or Word and get an interactive form app (list page + form page + record lifecycle), with e-signature and operation-audit components injected on demand, verified field by field and revisable via natural language.
agent.eform.name: Form Crafter
agent.eform.description: Team leader and single entry point: reads layout and field markers, generates the form app (list page + form page + record lifecycle), guards the field-level confirmation gate, and dispatches signature/audit injection by schema capabilities.
agent.esign.name: Signature Smith
agent.esign.description: E-signature specialist: injects the signature component into form pages — identity verification, handwriting capture, clear-and-resign before effect, locked on approval.
agent.eaudit.name: Auditor
agent.eaudit.description: Operation-audit specialist: injects the audit component — parameterized enablement, full logging of create/save/approve/print/export, view-only append-only journal.
team.studio.name: eForm Studio
team.studio.description: A three-board studio: form generation → signature injection → audit injection. The leader dispatches the two specialists by form capability flags; a shared anchor contract keeps injections from breaking page structure.
